mapper.select: SELECT id,outbox_id,user_id,shop_number,coupon_template_id,amount,status,retry_at,attempts,worker_id,lease_until,last_error,create_time,update_time FROM t_user_coupon_redeem_stock_ledger WHERE status='NEW' OR (status='RETRY' AND retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_stock_ledger SET status='PROCESSING',worker_id=#{workerId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_stock_ledger SET status='RETRY',retry_at=#{now},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now}
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_stock_ledger SET status='DONE',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND worker_id=#{workerId}
